objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default document name including document type abbreviation, number per type and title.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: properties
attributes.description: Document properties where standardized and customer-specific metadata can be maintained.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for the document.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

attributes.name: master_data
attributes.description: Example category for document metadata.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Existing source format used to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version, which can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status, which can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Document scope, which can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content of the document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned in the document properties; signs creation in the workflow.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Person assigned additional change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person assigned to review the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the document, including translation.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment used for reader authorizations.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity count starts for extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid from and Period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version required to be released before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader sees a released language version.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect email notification on next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect workflow task distribution on next released version.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint used to generate new documents.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted document format displayed on the web after saving.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user or person participating in document management, workflows, distribution, authorizations or acknowledgements.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to provide appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader access, distribution or archive access.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Defined group in the system used to assign read and change rights to a group of users/persons for each document.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to users, persons or groups for documents.

attributes.name: read_right
attributes.description: Right to read or view a document.

attributes.name: change_right
attributes.description: Right to change a document.

attributes.name: write_access
attributes.description: Access required to create a request for AKS for a selected document.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Functionality supporting complete traceability in approval processes.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main document release cycle and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content whose display is authorization-dependent.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content affecting the associated version of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status passed through from the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Validity matching the main document when released with extended validity.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document created without affecting the document content or version history.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of acknowledgement or completion described for reports and display.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated by email notifications.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, releases, validity extensions, change proposals, acknowledgements or distributions.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents and start the reactivation workflow.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning User Groups or persons for notification, acknowledgement or dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in the report listing acknowledgements.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled based on distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions or acknowledgements.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter available for reports and influencing evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion available for reports and filtering result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_system
attributes.description: Display mechanism indicating status based on validity or workflow timing.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard list of all documents relevant to a user.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-dependent version of a released document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.
